messages.subject: Filter Samples
messages.body_plain: I have my data in a metacoder object. Is there a way to filter it to a subset of the samples?
messages.body_snippet: I have my data in a metacoder object. Is there a way to filter it to a subset of the samples?

messages.subject: Re: Filter Samples
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Take a look at this tutorial and let me know if you still have questions:

https://grunwaldlab.github.io/metacoder_documentation/workshop--04--manipulating.html

Look at the section "Subsetting data classified by a taxonomy"

Best,

Zach
